title: Golden Oaklands Coin
body:
Golden Oaklands Coin

"I wonder what these were used for in the past?"

Golden Oaklands Coins are a coins larger than gold coins and have a letter on them, all the types of letters are O, A, K, (tree version) L, A, N, D, S. (rock version) they are obtainable from Pots of Gold that spawns around the map. If you get all 8 coins you can combine them into the word "oaklands", as seen in the picture above.
